text: Using AI to monitor AI agent transactions is fallacious because the monitoring AI inherits the same adaptive traits and potential flaws as the agents it oversees.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, How can we Best Monitor AI Agents (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5245185

isBasedOn.name: How can we Best Monitor AI Agents

abstract: The foundational premise of AI systems monitoring AI agent transactions introduces a fallacy, as the monitoring AI inherits the same adaptive traits and potential flaws as the agents it oversees.
